```json
      "codeBlock": {

          {
            "text": "- &#96;npm run typecheck&#96; - TypeScript type checking",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "### Adding New Content",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Create MDX file in appropriate &#96;src/content/articles/&#96; subdirectory",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Follow frontmatter schema for your content type",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Use automotive MDX components for consistent formatting",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Test locally before pushing",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📊 Content Strategy",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "### Monetization",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Primary**: Affiliate revenue through parts and tools recommendations",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Secondary**: Display ads (Mediavine/Raptive at scale)",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Tertiary**: Digital products (maintenance guides, checklists)",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "### SEO Focus",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "- Make/model-specific guides for long-tail dominance",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "- Symptom-first troubleshooting for high-volume searches",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "- Buyer guides for commercial intent keywords",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🔒 Safety &amp; Legal",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "All content includes appropriate safety warnings and disclaimers. The site emphasizes:",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "- Safety-first approach to all procedures",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "- Clear \"when to call a professional\" guidance",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "- Proper tool and equipment recommendations",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "- Vehicle-specific compatibility warnings",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📈 Analytics &amp; Monitoring",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "- Google Analytics 4 for traffic analysis",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "- Search Console for SEO monitoring",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "- Core Web Vitals tracking",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "- Affiliate link performance tracking",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 Deployment",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "The site deploys automatically to Vercel on push to main branch. No configuration needed - Astro is supported out of the box.",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "### Environment Variables",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;PUBLIC_SITE_URL&#96; - Site URL for canonical links",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "- Affiliate tracking IDs (when applicable)",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🤝 Contributing",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Focus on safety-first content",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Follow established MDX component patterns",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Include proper vehicle compatibility information",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Test all procedures before publishing",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "5. Maintain consistent voice and formatting",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📄 License",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "**Remember**: This site helps people save money on car maintenance, but safety always comes first. When in doubt, recommend professional service over DIY repairs.",
            "lineNumber": 187
          }
        ]
      },
```

```json
          {
            "text": "import { getCollection } from \"astro:content\";",

            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "export const getStaticPaths: GetStaticPaths = async () =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },

            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "  const articles = await getCollection(\"articles\", ({ data }) =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    const inMaintainHub = data.hubs.some((h: string) =&gt; MAINTAIN_HUBS.includes(h));",

          {
            "text": "    const isHowTo = data.articleType === \"how-to\" || data.articleType === \"maintenance-schedule\";",

          },
          {
            "text": "    return (inMaintainHub || isHowTo) &amp;&amp; !data.draft;",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  });",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "  return articles.map((entry) =&gt; ({",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "    params: { slug: entry.id },",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "    props: { entry },",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "  }));",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "};",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "const { entry } = Astro.props;",

          },
          {
            "text": "const { Content } = await entry.render();",

          },
          {
            "text": "---",

          },

          },
          {

          },
```

## 3. `/fix/[...slug]` - Dynamic Fix Articles (`fix/[...slug].astro`)

**Route:** `/fix/*` (catches all paths under `/fix/`)

**Full Contents:**
```1:27:src/pages/fix/[...slug].astro
---
import { getCollection } from "astro:content";
import type { GetStaticPaths } from "astro";
import Article from "../../layouts/Article.astro";

export const getStaticPaths: GetStaticPaths = async () => {
  const FIX_HUBS = ["electrical", "engine", "brakes", "ac-heating", "suspension", "noises-smells", "exhaust", "transmission"];
  const articles = await getCollection("articles", ({ data }) => {
    const inFixHub = data.hubs.some((h: string) => FIX_HUBS.includes(h));
    const isTroubleshooting = data.articleType === "troubleshooting";
    return (inFixHub || isTroubleshooting) && !data.draft;
  });

  return articles.map((entry) => ({
    params: { slug: entry.id },
    props: { entry },
  }));
};

const { entry } = Astro.props;
const { Content } = await entry.render();
---

<Article frontmatter={entry.data}>
  <Content />
</Article>
```

**Issues:**
- Dynamic route pattern: `[...slug]` catches all segments. If `entry.id` is a single slug (e.g., `car-wont-start-clicks`), the route will be `/fix/car-wont-start-clicks`. If it's multi-segment (e.g., `fix/brakes/squealing`), it will work as-is.
- Verify that article IDs match the expected URL structure

**Dependencies:**
- `Article.astro` layout — exists
- Content collection `articles` — configured in `content.config.ts`

```1:27:src/pages/maintain/[...slug].astro
import { getCollection } from "astro:content";
import type { GetStaticPaths } from "astro";
import Article from "../../layouts/Article.astro";

export const getStaticPaths: GetStaticPaths = async () => {
  const MAINTAIN_HUBS = ["oil-fluids", "tires", "filters", "belts-hoses", "coolant", "maintenance-schedules"];
  const articles = await getCollection("articles", ({ data }) => {
    const inMaintainHub = data.hubs.some((h: string) => MAINTAIN_HUBS.includes(h));
    const isHowTo = data.articleType === "how-to" || data.articleType === "maintenance-schedule";
    return (inMaintainHub || isHowTo) && !data.draft;
  });

  return articles.map((entry) => ({
    params: { slug: entry.id },
    props: { entry },
  }));
};

const { entry } = Astro.props;
const { Content } = await entry.render();
---

<Article frontmatter={entry.data}>
  <Content />
</Article>
```

```1:27:src/pages/buy/[...slug].astro
import { getCollection } from "astro:content";

export const getStaticPaths: GetStaticPaths = async () => {
  const BUY_HUBS = ["tools", "parts", "accessories", "buyer-guides"];
  const articles = await getCollection("articles", ({ data }) => {
    const inBuyHub = data.hubs.some((h: string) => BUY_HUBS.includes(h));
    const isBuyerContent = data.articleType === "buyer-guide" || data.articleType === "comparison";
    return (inBuyHub || isBuyerContent) && !data.draft;
  });

  return articles.map((entry) => ({
    params: { slug: entry.id },
    props: { entry },
  }));
};
```

```1:188:src/layouts/Layout.astro
---
export interface Props {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  canonical?: string;
  noIndex?: boolean;
}

const { title, description, canonical, noIndex = false } = Astro.props;

const siteTitle = "The Driveway Mechanic";
const tagline = "Fix it yourself. Save hundreds.";
const defaultDescription = "Learn to fix and maintain your car yourself with expert DIY guides, troubleshooting tips, and money-saving automotive advice.";

const fullTitle = title === siteTitle ? `${siteTitle} - ${tagline}` : `${title} | ${siteTitle}`;
const metaDescription = description || defaultDescription;
---

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" class="scroll-smooth">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg" />
    <link rel="sitemap" href="/sitemap-index.xml" />
    
    <title>{fullTitle}</title>
    <meta name="description" content={metaDescription} />
    
    {canonical && <link rel="canonical" href={canonical} />}
    {noIndex && <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow" />}
    
    <!-- Open Graph / Facebook -->
    <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
    <meta property="og:title" content={fullTitle} />
    <meta property="og:description" content={metaDescription} />
    <meta property="og:site_name" content={siteTitle} />
    
    <!-- Twitter -->
    <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
    <meta name="twitter:title" content={fullTitle} />
    <meta name="twitter:description" content={metaDescription} />
    
    <!-- Fonts -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
    
    <!-- Global Styles -->
    <style>
      :root {
        --background: 0 0% 100%;
        --foreground: 0 0% 3.9%;
      }
      
      .dark {
        --background: 0 0% 3.9%;
        --foreground: 0 0% 98%;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  
  <body class="min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground antialiased">
    <header class="sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-foreground/10 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div class="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">

                <span class="text-lg text-white">🔧</span>
              </div>

                <div class="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">The Driveway Mechanic</div>
                <div class="text-xs text-foreground/60 -mt-1">Fix it yourself. Save hundreds.</div>
              </div>
            </a>
          </div>

          <!-- Navigation -->
          <nav class="hidden md:block">
            <ul class="flex items-center gap-8 text-sm font-medium">
              <li><a href="/fix" class="text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground transition-colors">Fix & Troubleshoot</a></li>
              <li><a href="/maintain" class="text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground transition-colors">Maintain & Prevent</a></li>
              <li><a href="/buy" class="text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground transition-colors">Buy & Compare</a></li>
              <li><a href="/learn" class="text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground transition-colors">Learn</a></li>
              <li><a href="/seasonal" class="text-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground transition-colors">Seasonal</a></li>
            </ul>
          </nav>

          <!-- Mobile menu button -->
          <button id="mobile-menu-btn" class="md:hidden rounded-lg p-2 hover:bg-foreground/10" aria-label="Toggle menu" aria-expanded="false">
            <svg id="menu-icon-open" class="h-6 w-6" createIcon="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16" />
            </svg>
            <svg id="menu-icon-close" class="h-6 w-6 hidden" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">

            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <!-- Mobile menu panel -->
```
